bullets.title: Fed hikes 25bp to 3.75-4.0%; hawkish dot plot signals one more hike in 2026
bullets.body: Unanimous FOMC vote raised fed funds rate 25bp to 3.75-4.0%; 16 of 18 members project at least one more hike in 2026, with median dot now at 4.1% and some hawks at 4.3%. Chair Warsh flagged financial conditions are 'not restrictive,' removed supply-shock language, and the neutral rate was revised up to 3.2-3.25% — highest since 2016. Core PCE forecast revised to 3.4% for 2026; 10Y crossed 5.01%, 2Y +7bp to 4.74%.

bullets.title: JPM/Citi post-FOMC: buy Tech/Mag7 dips; short SMid-caps; neutral on broader equities
bullets.body: JPM US Market Intel maintains Tactically Cautious/Neutral but recommends long Tech/Mag7 and AI theme as dip-buy vs. short SMid-caps, noting semis and AI baskets held well post-Fed. Citi also neutral, saying equities can perform if cycle is 2-3 hikes then pause plus strong EPS, but flags AI model slowdown as a risk/reward headwind. NDX outperformed on the day; growth stocks +150bp vs. value -200bp.

bullets.title: INTC +4% on SK Hynix US memory manufacturing talks; Citi Buy, $130 PT
bullets.body: Reuters reported SK Hynix in exploratory talks with Intel to manufacture memory chips at the Ohio fab or via a JV with cloud providers — the first US-based HBM/memory manufacturing by Hynix. Citi maintains Buy with $130 PT (34% upside from ~$97), noting partnership complements Intel's 14A/EMIB-T advanced packaging roadmap and could expand SpaceX relationship.

bullets.title: GEV +4.8%: $200B backlog target on track for early 2027; Bernstein reiterates Buy
bullets.body: GE Vernova guided at the Morgan Stanley conference that 2H contract commitments should exceed 20GW and the $200B order backlog target is on track for early 2027; equipment backlog already $40B+ (~3 years revenue). Data centers represent ~38% of electrification orders. Bernstein reiterated Buy, citing durable utility spending. Seen as positive read-through for VRT, BE, and broader AI-infra group.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Blackstone secures ~$22-23B financing for Crux AI JV with Google
bullets.body: Blackstone lined up ~$22-23B from 10 banks for Crux AI, a US-based JV with Google offering data center capacity, networking, and Google Cloud TPUs as compute-as-a-service. Blackstone committed $5B in initial equity; first 500MW expected online 2027 with plans to scale significantly. Google executive Benjamin Treynor Sloss named CEO.

bullets.title: ON Investor Day: 12-14% revenue CAGR to $11B by 2030; stock -8.6% intraday
bullets.body: Onsemi targets 53% gross margin, 38% operating margin, and 30-35% FCF margin by 2030 vs. 2026E of ~40%/22%/25% respectively — requiring operating income to grow >2x revenue. AI data center set to >2x in 2026 then double again in 2027. Synaptics acquisition described as margin-accretive accelerator. Despite ambitious targets, shares fell ~8.6% intraday during the presentation. Subaru also announced a strategic engagement with ON to evaluate its Embedded Power Platform for electrified vehicles.

bullets.title: CIEN +1.9%: FY29 targets — 30% revenue CAGR, ~50% gross margin, 32-35% op margin
bullets.body: Ciena announced ambitious FY29 financial targets including ~30% revenue CAGR from 2026-2029, adjusted gross margin ~50%, adjusted operating margin 32-35%, and ~20% FCF margin. New reporting segments launch FY27 covering Optical Systems, Interconnects, Global Services, and Routing. Stock was halted ahead of the announcement and closed up 1.9%.

bullets.title: CRWV +3.0%: Blockfusion signs 15-year anchor lease at Niagara Falls AI campus
bullets.body: CoreWeave gained 3% after Blockfusion signed a 15-year anchor lease at its Niagara Falls AI data center campus, adding durable long-term revenue visibility to CoreWeave's infrastructure buildout.

bullets.title: EXPE initiated Underweight at Morgan Stanley on weaker consumer positioning
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley initiated Expedia at Underweight, citing weaker consumer positioning and slower user growth versus peers. Stock fell 2.1% on the day.

bullets.title: CRM (Salesforce): Citi Neutral, $233 PT; Dreamforce checks more constructive but execution risks persist
bullets.body: Citi's Dreamforce channel checks showed a notably more constructive tone versus a year ago — shift from AI experimentation to tangible ROI, strong Financial Services Cloud upsells, and the Koa reasoning model matching leading benchmarks. However, customer confusion, flat spend intentions, and M&A (INFA) execution risk keep Citi at Neutral with a $233 PT (-8.9% from $255.65). Buy-vs-build pendulum seen swinging back to enterprise software vendors.

bullets.title: FSLR -5.6%: Withdraws ITC TOPCon complaint but continues IP suits vs. CSIQ, Jinko
bullets.body: First Solar plans to withdraw its USITC TOPCon patent complaint but will continue lawsuits against CSIQ, Jinko Solar, and others. Solar sector broadly weak on rising interest rate concerns following hawkish Fed. ROTH Capital sees incremental timing risk for 2027 project starts but maintains bullish long-term outlook for utility-scale solar.

bullets.title: AAPL +0.3%: Developing enterprise AI server with custom M8 Ultra chips and NVDA networking
bullets.body: Apple is reportedly developing an enterprise AI server using custom M8 Ultra chips integrated with Nvidia networking technology, signaling Apple's push into the AI infrastructure market for enterprise customers.

bullets.title: META: Zuckerberg sides with Huang on AI safety; camera-free smart glasses planned
bullets.body: Meta CEO Zuckerberg aligned with Nvidia's Jensen Huang on AI safety at the FOMC-day conference. Meta is also reportedly planning camera-free smart glasses as its next hardware iteration. In credit markets, Meta CDS tightened 8-10bps MTD with minimal bank hedging flow, while hyperscaler capex is expected to surge 60% to $1.4T in 2027, moving FCF negative.

bullets.title: APP: KeyBanc raises PT to $280 (OW) on resident services ARPU opportunity
bullets.body: KeyBanc raised its AppFolio price target from $255 to $280 (Overweight), modeling $100+ monthly ARPU per tenant with ~20% take rate via the Second Nature bundled services partnership (internet, pest control, air filters, credit building). Adoption is nascent with regulatory restrictions in CA/CO/MA/NY/OR, but channel checks show positive feedback. 2027E revenue estimate $1.31B.

bullets.title: DKNG: NJ August sports betting GGR -39% Y/Y; market share fell to 28% from 34%
bullets.body: New Jersey August sports betting data showed DraftKings GGR down 39% Y/Y with market share declining to 28% from 34%, partly attributable to calendar headwinds (nine vs. ten weekend days). iGaming GGR was also -2% Y/Y. Separately, the 9th Circuit reversed a lower court ruling, finding tribes likely to succeed on claims that Kalshi's sports event contracts on tribal lands violate IGRA — a modest structural positive for licensed operators like DKNG.

bullets.title: TSLA: High diesel prices ($6+) flagged as tailwind for Tesla Semi adoption
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley highlighted Tesla Semi as a beneficiary of elevated diesel prices exceeding $6/gallon, which accelerates the freight transportation shift to electric. Autonomous trucking adoption also cited as an accelerating catalyst.

bullets.title: Hyperscaler capex set to surge 60% to $1.4T in 2027; GOOGL/AMZN CDS wider on hedging flows
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley credit desk estimates hyperscalers issued ~$230B in bonds YTD; 2027 capex of $1.4T (up from $860B in 2026) will require heavier debt funding and push FCF negative. Google and Amazon CDS are wider due to material hedging flows, while Meta and Broadcom CDS tightened. Data-center secured HY supply expected to slow due to political pushback.

bullets.title: EQIX: Secaucus data center diesel spill draws regulatory scrutiny; House to vote on Ratepayer Protection Act
bullets.body: An Equinix data center in Secaucus, NJ spilled 5,000+ gallons of diesel into the Hackensack River. The House is set to vote on the Ratepayer Protection Act amid 65% voter opposition to unhindered data center development, adding regulatory overhang to the DC REIT sector. Data Center REITs still up +26.5% YTD despite today's mixed session.

bullets.title: MSFT, DELL, SNOW, NOW, ROKU: Hedgeye flags as top signal-strength longs
bullets.body: Hedgeye's proprietary fractal-math Risk Range model identifies MSFT, TEAM, DELL, SNOW, NOW, and ROKU as bullish on both TRADE (≤3 weeks) and TREND (≥3 months) durations based on price, volume, and volatility inputs.

bullets.title: MRVL +3.6%, SHOP +1.6% among Canada-listed gainers; MRVL NYC mgmt meeting Oct 7
bullets.body: Marvell gained 3.6% on the TSX with no specific catalyst cited intraday. Shopify rose 1.6% following earnings. Separately, Jefferies has scheduled a Marvell CEO/CFO management meeting in NYC on October 7 — potential catalyst for updated guidance or AI networking commentary.
